subject: Freight Invoice Dispute — FR-2026-0842 (Shipment SHIP-00421)
body:
Dear Billing Team,

We have reviewed invoice FR-2026-0842 issued by Atlantic Ocean Lines for shipment SHIP-00421 against the applicable contractual rate and identified a billing discrepancy that we would like to raise for your review.

- Billed amount: EUR 42,500.00
- Contractual amount: EUR 24,000.00
- Disputed amount: EUR 18,500.00
- Calculation: EUR 42,500.00 − (EUR 24,000.00 × 1) = EUR 18,500.00

Supporting evidence:
1. Invoice (invoice-sample.pdf):
   "1 | Ocean Freight | Shanghai (CNSHA) to Rotterdam (NLRTM) | 40HC | 1 | EUR 42,500.00 | EUR 42,500.00"
2. Contract (contract-sample.pdf, clause 4.2.1):
   "4.2.1 Ocean Freight | Shanghai (CNSHA) to Rotterdam (NLRTM) | 40HC | EUR 24,000.00 per container"

We kindly request that you review this charge and issue a credit note or reimbursement of the disputed amount of EUR 18,500.00 relating to invoice FR-2026-0842.

Please let us know if you require any further information.

Kind regards,
Freight Audit Team
